# R4.7f — Audit link obligations — `subagent_anchor` + `producer_resolution` graduate (DF-S1.15-1 hermetic members)

Spec: `docs/tickets/156f_R4.7f__audit-link-obligations.md` (seq 156f).
Depends on R4.7e (stacked; base `svitali/harnessharness-r4.7e` @
`c71d5ad`). Requirement ids: **DF-S1.15-1** (link members) ·
**BL-05** · **R-2.8.6**.

## Summary

- **Both `DEFERRED_OBLIGATIONS` links graduate into `OBLIGATIONS`**
  (`crates/hh-ledger/src/audit.rs`) — the way `fleet_anchor` (S4.9) and
  `evolution_link` (S6.1a) graduated. `DEFERRED_OBLIGATIONS` is now
  `&[]`: the row's only residual is signer-key custody (OQ-170), which
  is not an obligation id and stays routed to R4.15e.
- **`subagent_anchor`** — every `control.subagent.spawned` joins the
  child run's seq-0 `lifecycle.run.created`: the child manifest's
  `spawn_event` names the spawned row, `parent_run_id` names the parent,
  and `extra.parent_anchor{run_id,seq,hash}` is byte-equal to the
  spawned row's `parent_head_at_spawn` (I-A6 reciprocal citation). A
  `result|cancelled` terminal must re-cite the spawned row's
  `delegation_ref` and carry `child_head{seq,hash}` re-verified against
  the child's durable prefix (`events[seq].hash == hash`). `detached`
  (T6) discharges on the creation anchor alone; the recovery row
  `cancelled{failure_kind:spawn_interrupted}` discharges only when no
  child run is held — a held child contradicts it. `terminal_only = true`:
  a mid-run spawn without a terminal is pending, not a violation.
- **`producer_resolution`** — every non-kernel
  `producer.component_variant_ref` resolves to a
  `security.extension.loaded` pin-attestation member (`extension_id`,
  `content` or `resolved` — §5g.5 §6's attestation coordinates) or a
  sealed-definition/registry member (the run's `harness_def_ref`, or a
  `lifecycle.registry.*` `version_id`). `"none"`/empty is the declared
  unbound spelling; kernel variant refs are kernel-internal component
  labels — sealed-definition members adjudicated by Rule P, never
  registered-producer references.
- **`eval_obligations`/`eval_obligation`/`audit_view`** gained
  `manifest: &RunManifest` + `other_events: Fn(&str) ->
  Option<Vec<EventEnvelope>>` — the cross-run half of the subagent join.
  `Store::project(ViewKind::AuditView)` resolves a named run's durable
  prefix from the same store (`None` = run not held → unmet — honest
  refusal, never a fabricated anchor). Existing call sites updated
  (`s3_11b.rs`, `s4_14b_rotation.rs`).
- **DF-S1.15-1 dated note** appended — the row's full scope-column
  membership enumerated against dated markers: compact-range heads +
  `security.audit.checkpoint` emitters, signed checkpoints over
  `signer_key_ids`, inclusion/consistency proofs, `cross_run` view member
  + auditor — S2.5 (2026-09-19); `fleet_anchor` + escalation emitters —
  S4.9 (2026-09-27); `evolution_link` — S6.1a (2026-10-02); gc/redact
  durable-before-delete emitters + redaction endorsement — R2.13
  (2026-10-08); `subagent_anchor` + `producer_resolution` — R4.7f
  (2026-10-22, landed here); signer custody — OQ-170 → R4.15e (the row's
  only residual). BL-05 landing cell carries the dated append.
